name: headroom-hud
description: HUD band and side pane: model/effort, context gauge, session cost, headroom proxy savings, and guided /compact.

autoDock.title: Auto-dock side pane
autoDock.description: Automatically open the side pane in fullscreen terminals at least 144 columns wide.

showCost.title: Show session cost & sparkline
showCost.description: Display session USD cost estimate and recent per-turn cost sparkline.

showCategories.title: Show context categories
showCategories.description: Display top used context categories (messages, MCP tools, memory, etc.) in the side pane.

showTurnsLeft.title: Show turns-left estimate
showTurnsLeft.description: Display estimated turns remaining before compaction in the side pane.

showElapsed.title: Show session duration
showElapsed.description: Display elapsed session time in the side pane.

showCache.title: Show prompt-cache countdown
showCache.description: Display remaining prompt-cache warmth (warm/cold) between turns in the side pane.

showAgents.title: Show running subagents
showAgents.description: Display active subagent count in the band and side pane.

showRateLimits.title: Show rate-limit windows
showRateLimits.description: Display 5-hour / 7-day / spend rate-limit windows and reset countdowns in the side pane.

showProxy.title: Show Headroom proxy stats
showProxy.description: Poll and display Headroom proxy token/cost savings and version.
